credits.title: The Riverbank
credits.overview: Izaquiel works as a cleaner in Recife, a Brazilian city intertwined with rivers and mangroves. At night, he dangerously ventures out in search of secret encounters in the mangrove forest. His world shifts when he crosses paths with Jeremias, an intriguing and magnetic fisherman.

credits.title: Forest of the End of the World
credits.overview: Suely, an Indigenous woman living in a large Brazilian city, spends her days in a small apartment. In her dreams, she communicates with a forest and connects to secrets of a world undergoing radical changes.

credits.title: The Secret Agent
credits.overview: Brazil, 1977. Marcelo, a technology expert in his early 40s, is on the run. Hoping to reunite with his son, he travels to Recife during Carnival but soon realizes that the city is not the safe haven he was expecting.

credits.title: A Whale Can Be Torn Apart Like a Samba School
credits.overview: It’s Carnival in Rio. A young man wanders through the streets of the city and the remains of the huge cardboard parade floats. credits.title: Latin Blood – The Ballad of Ney Matogrosso
credits.overview: From a repressive childhood to artistic revolution, Ney Matogrosso transforms Brazil's stages — and himself — through music, creativity and inner fire.

credits.title: The Death of Lazarus
credits.overview: Marta and Maria mourn the death of their brother Lázaro. A group of Jews try to comfort Maria while Marta leaves to meet Jesus. The disciples try to warn their master about the dangers of returning to Judea. Nearby, a miracle is about to happen.
